scope: One live NEAR AI coordinator call; real finalized mainnet reads; internal commissioning request, no customer signature or payment

mission.goal: Prepare a factual Econia project review: inspect the project account and contract, verify Mira NFT ownership, and reconcile the wrapped NEAR balance. Delegate each supplied target to the appropriate specialist and combine their evidence.

plan.summary: Plan uses the full 1-call budget on this coordination step, so no source-brief or copy-edit calls are possible; specialist delegation tools cost 0. Each supplied source maps to exactly one approved specialist: near-account inspects the project account, near-contract inspects the deployed contract, near-nft verifies Mira NFT ownership for the token, and near-token reconciles the wrap.near balance. Four independent steps, no overlap, and the assembler merges all checked outputs into the factual Econia review.

steps.reason: Account specialist inspects the Econia project account data; this is the only source supporting near-account.
Contract specialist reviews the project contract; matches goal item 2 and the contracts-0 source.
NFT specialist verifies Mira NFT ownership using the token and claimed-owner data in nfts-0.
Token specialist reconciles the wrap.near balance for the project account recorded in tokens-0.

checks: Every specialist delivered a checked result
Source and artifact hashes rechecked before assembly
output.review: Review the combined specialist reports. Trial acceptance does not transfer NEAR.
